create_GymEnvironment_from_name: create a GymEnvironment wrapper from a gym environment name string like CartPole-v1
create_GymEnvironment_from_instance: create a GymEnvironment wrapper from an existing gym.Env instance with custom args
reset_GymEnvironment: reset the GymEnvironment with an optional seed and get the initial observation and action space
step_GymEnvironment: step the GymEnvironment with a Pearl Action and get an ActionResult with observation and reward
convert_Pearl_action_to_gym: convert a Pearl Action to a gym-compatible action using the PEARL_TO_GYM_ACTION mapping
